observations: Perspective conversion clears up/direction locks before the already-perspective/symmetry early return; location lock remains.
The early path changes lens only when a valid positive request differs from the reported lens by strictly more than0.125; its lens setter return is ignored and initial validity return is retained.
Invalid/nonpositive requested target distance uses TargetDistance(true) before symmetric-frustum dolly and symmetry flags are applied.
The parallel-to-perspective helper sets projection before checking frustum validity; failure can retain that mutation.
The helper records the old absolute frustum width and target width-plane point, raises near to1e-8 when near<1e-8 and far>=1e-7, then applies lens through the existing source setter.

When the source width plane is valid and camera location is unlocked, the helper can move camera backward along CameraZ to keep the old target plane visible; a failed location setter does not replace the helper lens return.
Only a successful outer result with an initially valid stored target invokes the source target recenter helper.
